DRIP & DUSK / CUSTOMER CARE

Shipping & delivery policy

Where we deliver, what it costs and when to expect your order.

Last updated 29 October 2026

Where we deliver

We deliver to addresses across India that our courier partners can serve. If we cannot deliver to your PIN code, we will contact you and refund the order in full.

Delivery charges

Delivery is charged at a flat rate shown at checkout before you pay.

Dispatch and delivery times

  • Orders are usually dispatched within 1–3 working days after payment is confirmed.
  • Delivery typically takes 3–7 working days after dispatch, depending on your location.
  • Perfume is a flammable item, so couriers may send it by road rather than air, which can add time for remote areas. Courier delays outside our control can happen; we will help you follow up.

Tracking

Every order has a private tracking page. Once your order ships, the courier name, AWB number and tracking link appear there.

Receiving your parcel

Please check the parcel when it arrives. If it is damaged, leaking or not what you ordered, tell us within 48 hours of delivery with photos or an unboxing video. See our Refund & cancellation policy.
